calculation.title: Calculation Basis
items: The higher of the weight step and the size step (sum of three sides) applies (not volumetric weight ÷6000)
Parcels exceeding the size limit (L+W+H) are not accepted
Extra charges for Jeju and remote islands vary by carrier (Korea Post charges none from the mainland to Jeju)
Same-region shipping is about 500–1,000 KRW cheaper

tips.title: Saving Tips
items: Store-to-store delivery is cheapest: CU/GS25 half-price delivery (up to 5 kg, 1,800–2,700 KRW) and 7-Eleven budget delivery (up to 20 kg, 1,980 KRW)
Korea Post regular parcel (counter): the cheapest home-delivered option when tracking isn't needed
Shrinking the box by one size step (sum of three sides) can lower the fare
Jeju surcharges differ by several thousand won between carriers
Korea Post accepts up to 30 kg (more generous than other carriers)

whatIs.title: What is the Shipping Cost Calculator?
whatIs.description: The Shipping Cost Calculator lets you compare 2026 personal shipping rates from major Korean carriers — CJ Logistics, Lotte Delivery, Hanjin, Logen, Korea Post, and convenience store delivery services. Enter the weight, box size (sum of three sides), and destination (mainland, Jeju, or remote islands) to get estimated costs across all carriers. Particularly useful for frequent shippers and e-commerce operators.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Enter the package weight (kg) and dimensions (L×W×H in cm). Picking a Korea Post box size fills in the dimensions.
2. Select the destination (mainland, Jeju, or remote islands); regional rates are applied automatically.
3. Choose the delivery type (standard courier or convenience store drop-off).
4. Estimated fees for each carrier are calculated and sorted by price.

items.q: Is the fare based on weight or size?
items.a: Domestic Korean parcels are charged at the higher of the weight step and the size step (L+W+H). For example, a 2 kg Korea Post registered parcel with a 110 cm size sum pays the 100–120 cm step (6,000 KRW). Volumetric weight (÷6000), as used for air freight, is not applied.

items.q: How much is the Jeju Island surcharge?
items.a: It varies by carrier. In this calculator, personal shipments to Jeju cost about 2,000–3,000 KRW extra and remote islands about 4,000–5,000 KRW. Korea Post charges no surcharge from the mainland to Jeju or islands; delivery just takes longer (only next-day delivery from Jeju to the mainland costs more).

items.q: What's the difference between convenience store and standard courier?
items.a: Convenience store delivery (at CU, GS25, etc.) requires you to drop off the package yourself but can offer lower rates for small parcels compared to standard door-to-door pickup.
